instruction.text: Lies den Text über Donald aufmerksam und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.text: Hello, I'm Donald the dolphin. I live in the ocean.

atoms.a:
Where does Donald live?
Wo lebt Donald?

instruction.text: Lies den Text über Donald aufmerksam und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.text: These are my friends: William the whale, Severus the starfish and Thomas the turtle.

atoms.a:
How many friends does Donald have?
Wie viele Freunde hat Donald?
atoms.sound: How many friends does Donald have?

instruction.text: Lies den Text über Donald aufmerksam und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.text: We spend the day playing underwater-basketball.

atoms.a:
What do Donald and his friends play?
Was spielen Donald und seine Freunde?
atoms.sound: What do Donald and his friends play?

instruction.text: Lies den Text über Donald aufmerksam und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.text: Sometimes I swim to the surface and play with the humans.

atoms.a:
What does Donald do at the surface?
Was macht Donald an der Wasseroberfläche?
atoms.sound: What does Donald do at the surface?

instruction.text: Lies den Text über Donald aufmerksam und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.text: I like the surface, but I prefer to live underwater.

atoms.a:
Where does Donald prefer to live?
Wo lebt Donald lieber?
atoms.sound: Where does Donald prefer to live?
